state.image_description: A moonlit pine forest. A luminous full moon in the upper right, tall dark evergreen silhouettes on both sides, a winding silver stream through the center, distant blue mountains beneath a deep navy night sky. Restrained teal and silver pixel art, readable silhouettes, no text or border.
state.coordinates: Origin (0,0) at top left. x increases right, y increases down. Each cell is half as wide as it is tall, so the full image appears square.
state.task: Compose one coherent recognizable pixel-art image. Choose the palette color at each requested coordinate.
